title: FAA-PMA Submission Checklist
note: Organization-agnostic form. The tool produces this completed and attaches it to the submission. Tenant supplies only the form number/revision shown in the footer and the people who sign it.

supplementSource.prompt: Please check the PMA Supplement Source

signoffNote: Write your employee id or name once revised.

items.text: Use the application letter template according to the PMA supplement source.

subitems.detail: Single source: TC Holder or STC variant. Multiple source: TC Holder or STC variant.

subitems.text: Fill out the variable fields of the letter chosen.
subitems.detail: Use the assist letter for TC Holder, or the front page of the approved STC.

items.text: Use the PMA Supplement template, populated from the TC Holder or STC information.
items.detail: Follow the organization's current supplement development procedure.

subitems.text: Complete the supplement per the development procedure.
How many items were included on the PMA supplement:
How many pages were used on the PMA supplement:
subitems.detail: Observe the page-count guidance; if exceeded, notify the FAA office of the total.

items.text: Review of the source approval (assist letter or STC) against the application letter and PMA supplement.

subitems.text: Verify the following information matches between the three documents: 1. Assist Letter or STC, 2. Application Letter, 3. PMA Supplement.

checks.where: source approval / application letter (paragraph 1 or table) / supplement
source approval / application letter (paragraph 2 or table) / supplement
source approval / application letter (paragraph 1 or table) / supplement

checks.note: Apply the organization's model-prefix convention; use 'Series' or 'Models' as the source approval does; add special notes or exceptions as applicable.

checks.where: application letter last paragraph vs. paragraphs 1 and 2 (or table) of the same letter

checks.item: Index List / Drawing List / component drawing
checks.where: attachment vs. the one shown on the source approval

items.text: Attach this checklist to the submission.
